# Anti-Patterns

Avoid:

- card soup;
- generic dashboard layouts selected before understanding the case;
- large empty marketing-style application screens;
- decorative metrics and charts;
- silent overwrites;
- hidden provenance;
- tooltips as the only source of important meaning;
- modal-heavy workflows;
- wizards that hide future stages;
- step completion treated as inherently positive;
- No-Go styled as failure or destructive error;
- decorative color;
- animation on every screen load;
- excessive novelty in ordinary controls;
- mobile layouts that remove process orientation;
- UI kits whose interaction model conflicts with the method.

The interface is not a form builder, dashboard, or task checklist. It is a visible method of casework.
